arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Wolfson stated the Coal Act aimed to prevent the collapse of a private health care system.
Mr. Wolfson argued section 9701(c)(2) targets signatory operators and related successors.
Mr. Woodrum noted lower courts addressed successor liability before the Eastern Enterprises case.
Mr. Woodrum claimed the Commissioner argued the Coal Act did not provide for successor liability.
